**Finding: deviation (§ 12.1 License)**

The grant in § 12.1 fails the fallback on two material terms:

1. **Revocability** — the licence is expressly "revocable" with no standard attached, meaning IBM can withdraw our right to use the Base Components at its discretion. That is explicit walk-away territory under the rule.
2. **Permitted users** — only "Customer" is named. Neither Affiliates (defined at p0015) nor Subcontractors (defined at p0031) are covered, and § 14.17 (Limitation of Licenses) forecloses any implied extension, so there is no path to add them.

Transferability is already acceptable: § 14.10 permits assignment to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition, so I did not touch it (and did not double-flag it).

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted — it adds Affiliates and Subcontractors acting on our behalf, and limits revocation to termination for our uncured material breach, with affiliate-coverage-on-notice offered as the fallback in the comment.
